name: Magical Arms Angel☆Nana
original_name: 魔法戦姫〈Magical Arms〉エンジェル☆ナナ
source:
One day, two magician girls are transferred to a high school. The purpose of their transfer is to make black art magicians who are lurking in school powerless. And their target black magician is Shusuke. But, he notices their secret plan, and he immediately takes an action to make them his sex slaves...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305064038/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1008052]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
某天，两名魔法少女转入一所高中。她们的目的是让潜伏在校内的黑魔法师失去力量，而目标正是修介。可修介识破了秘密计划，立刻采取行动，要把两人变成自己的性爱奴隶……
